'''Val DeGoort''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was the commander of the [[Valor (Imperial-class)|''Valor'']], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. After an incident where the Valor collided with another [[Star Destroyer/Legends|star destroyer]] during a close-approach coordinated-action exercise, DeGoort and his ship were transferred to [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] as a "penal" assignment.
